title: Experimental Design & Inference
description: Go beyond descriptives into the mechanics of statistical inference: hypothesis testing, p-values, Type I/II errors, A/B test design, sample size estimation, the Central Limit Theorem, and Bayesian reasoning for real product decisions.
focus_concepts: TYPE I AND TYPE II ERRORS
outcomes: You will be able to set up a valid hypothesis test, interpret p-values correctly, distinguish Type I and Type II errors, calculate minimum detectable effect for an A/B test, apply the Central Limit Theorem to sampling distributions, and explain the Bayesian perspective on evidence.
